sensor_definitions.height: Direct rigidly transported positions; no displacement inferred from velocity RMS.

step_definitions.phase_apex: Desired >= .032 m (80% of 4 cm); same old analysis mask, not a new objective.
step_definitions.lag: Actual within-desired-window peak minus desired apex; negative is a lead. Repeated held desired at 200 Hz.
step_definitions.physical: Existing swing_events 6/10 N hysteresis and >=2 mm lift; censored separate.
step_definitions.reward: Rate then dt=.02 exactly once; no reward changes. Zero-clearance ratio is a counterfactual cost ratio, not dragging duration.
step_definitions.high_rate: Only positive lateral used at 200 Hz; policy-rate primary comparisons.

decision.action: Do not promote final1998 or intermediate1750. Retain geometric CK1000 as the schema2 development baseline, close the original training budget, and pause additional training.
rationale: Final1998 improves negative-lateral path, direct lateral body-x bias, unloading/timing and several sensor metrics relative to1000, but worsens holding, all stop residual translation and positive-lateral path.
Final forward curvature remains0.845m/7.105deg despite accurate speed. CK1750 reaches0.687m/6.082deg but has still worse holding/stopping; it does not resolve selection ambiguity.

CK1000 better preserves zero-command function while retaining useful geometric lateral/rolling-pose gains. Its1.024m forward cross-track remains an unresolved functional limitation, not a qualification pass.

A stronger translating-heading scale cannot directly address the zero-command regression because geometric eligibility is zero there. The bounded evidence does not identify one existing scale that addresses both failures without unsupported causal assumptions.
No timing/execution bug or reward-shape defect was demonstrated. Camera improvement depends partly on translation-rotation cancellation, so camera-only tuning is not the priority.
limitations: CK1750 was evaluated only on stand and forward, not lateral/yaw.
No policy is qualified for the expanded command envelope, DR/pushes, transfer or hardware by this panel.
The privileged critic does not expose accumulated path offset to the actor.

forward.cross_track_definition: Line through moving-segment start pose along its initial heading; heading from unwrapped pose projection, not integrated body angular-z
forward.speed: Report achieved body vx, bias and RMSE alongside trajectory; slowing/stopping to meet the path targets is unacceptable. Use .45-.55 m/s mean and <=.04 m/s RMSE as a declared development comparison band.

stand.rotation: Also report late body angular-z RMS/bias and full 30 s pose-derived heading change. Both must improve over CK499 (.00670 rad/s RMS, -11.1 deg); translation alone cannot qualify holding. Retain comparison to CK250 (.00030 rad/s late RMS).
stand.startup: Report 0-5 s displacement/path separately from late hold

frozen_requirements.stopping: No material increase in full 8 s stop path, backward excursion/reversal, or final residual motion versus CK499. Report endpoint and path separately, early braking and final 2 s XY/yaw; compare CK250 and original V3 too. CK499 fast stop endpoint/path .0311/.1051 m, final XY RMS .00544 m/s.
frozen_requirements.stepping: Retain both lateral and yaw signs, partial +/- .03 commands, physical cycles/clearance distribution and loaded motion; no material regression in tracking/cross-axis drift or transitions. Existing partial lateral cross-axis drift remains unqualified.
frozen_requirements.placement: Move actual front/rear widths and pair midpoints toward the saved corridor while retaining support, height, tracking, stops and necessary corrective actions; no falls/non-wheel contacts or worsening saturation hidden by averages.
frozen_requirements.material_change: Use the previous approximately 15% comparison bands descriptively for stop path/reversal and retained-step metrics; inspect absolute magnitudes, censored cycles and signs. This is not a universal pass/fail or safety certification. Do not silently relax the stated path/heading/stand targets after results.

limitations: Single nominal initial condition and seed; no envelope, DR, push, transfer or hardware qualification.
Contacts are sampled; 200 Hz only positive lateral. Control-force getter is not an integrated contact impulse.
Camera rigid motion is not measured image quality; wheel-center lateral speed is not tire-contact-patch slip.
Mean-square cross term is retained. Swing-lift component decomposition is descriptive, not causal.
Privileged critic does not provide the actor online accumulated offset; no arbitrary path-recovery guarantee.
Schema1 raw baselines reused only. Any geometric rescoring is counterfactual, not their original objective.
Global training term averages are not matched family/phase/hold costs or policy gradients.
